successful_response_headers.note: The custom header counter differs by one event from the Locust aggregate CSV. Locust aggregate statistics are used for success and error percentages.

resources.note: Peak observed values from periodic kubectl top sampling.

cost_estimate.limitations: Steady-state two-replica estimate. Excludes SeaweedFS, Traefik, control-plane, storage, network and other infrastructure costs.

slo_and_error_budget.scope: A short two-minute laboratory load test, not a production 30-day SLO measurement.

limitations_and_improvements: Eight requests returned HTTP 500 because generated model output failed JSON/schema validation.
The offline v1 validation set measured 96% JSON validity, consistent with the invalid-output issue under load.
CPU peaks approached the one-vCPU limit; HPA scaled to two replicas during load.
The p95 latency was close to the proposed five-second target.
The cluster uses one k3d node and does not demonstrate multi-node high availability.
Potential improvements include constrained decoding, a carefully tested output-repair retry, better training coverage, CPU/GPU optimization, and repeated longer-duration load tests.
